body: Which is the correct technique for hand hygiene with soap and water?
options: Rinse with water only for 5 seconds
Use alcohol rub on visibly soiled hands
Wet hands, apply soap, rub all surfaces for 40–60 seconds, rinse and dry
explanation: WHO technique; alcohol rub takes 20–30 seconds on non-soiled hands.

subject: GNX

options: only after removing gloves at the end of a shift
explanation: Before patient contact, before aseptic tasks, after body fluid exposure, after patient contact, after touching surroundings.

explanation: Bed numbers are never an identifier.

subject: GNX
